The '''Treefall Gorge''' was a site on [[Denova]] that was a point of conflict during the [[Battle of Denova]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Treefall Gorge appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation.<ref name="SWTOR" />
